Keep your elephants on Green's west face and towered elephants, and we crush the archers between us. Neutral to you; I'll share sightings every turn.
private_messages.Grok: Executing as agreed: Green set to enemy at t=500. Swordsmen and elephant are on Green's southern Cretans now.
